name: Locate and remove physical disks from a device
description: Locate the physical storage media inside a device and remove it, so that it can be connected to an examination system for acquisition.
details:
This applies to devices such as desktop computers, laptops and servers where storage media is installed as a separate, detachable component. Examples include 2.5" and 3.5" SATA drives, M.2 SATA and NVMe SSDs, and mSATA drives.

The removed media is typically then connected via a hardware write blocker (DFT-1012), or connected directly (DFT-1166) with a software write blocker (DFT-1013).

Where storage is soldered to the motherboard, alternatives can be used e.g.,
- Accessing the storage in place via a bootable environment (DFT-1113).
- Removing the storage chip itself (DFT-1028).
